headline: Put local air quality on your dashboard
intro: Connect Home Assistant to Airly with an API key and a location to retrieve air quality readings from nearby measuring stations. Depending on what the closest station reports, sensors can include Common Air Quality Index (CAQI), particulate matter, gases, humidity, pressure, and temperature, with Airly's level, description, and advice available as CAQI attributes.
highlights: Follow the Common Air Quality Index and its level, description, and advice attributes
Track reported measurements such as PM1, PM2.5, PM10, carbon monoxide, nitrogen dioxide, ozone, and sulphur dioxide
Use readings in automations, such as notifications for a CAQI above 75 or purifier controls at PM2.5 thresholds

flow.title: From Airly API key to local readings
stages: Get a free API key from Airly for developers
Add Airly in Home Assistant with the API key and location
Use available station measurements in sensors and automations
